snippet.title: Tearoom of Terror Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome, proprietor, to your new tearoom. You’re responsible for completing orders, handling morally questionable requests, and perhaps causing—I mean, solving—a murder or two. So please, come inside and meet the odd and macabre customers you’ll be serving. They’re dying to meet you…

Wishlist Tearoom of Terror now on Steam!
